item.title: A New Solution for Fragmented Markets: The Integrated Post-Trade Operating Model
item.description: As market complexity increases, connecting clearing, settlement, collateral and liquidity can help firms reduce operational friction and put capital to work more effectively.

item.title: Modernizing the Payments Operating Model
item.description: Payments modernization today goes beyond upgrading rails: It’s about redesigning the operating model for a continuous, data-rich – and increasingly intelligent – rail-agnostic payments environment. In this paper, BNY shares insights from its own transformation journey and the development of a new payments platform designed to help clients move modernization forward with greater clarity and confidence.

item.title: The Custody Edge: Connecting Markets, Assets and Intelligence
item.description: The role of a custodian is rapidly evolving beyond traditional safekeeping and settlement functions to become a strategic growth partner that leverages advanced technology, data analytics, and integrated, connected platforms to enhance transparency, operational efficiency and risk management for investors.
